patch_description: Implements the recommended matched co-move: widen the Savitzky-Golay window to 2W+11 and steepen the recency-weight tilt to e^-1.0 as a pair. The prior (2W+7, e^-1.2) sweep was the only configuration that broke the 0.62 plateau (+0.04 smoothness, −5 reversals for only +0.02 lag), and generational history confirms window and tilt must move together or the interaction turns destructive. The wider SG window suppresses residual level variance, co-targeting smoothness and noise reduction, while the slightly gentler tilt (e^-1.0 vs e^-1.2) keeps lag error nearly unchanged. The Kalman pre-filter (soft NIS-capped), 5-tap median snap, and trend-lock reversal hysteresis are retained unchanged. The `sg_win > len(x_kalman)` clamp and valid-mode convolution are preserved exactly.
